{{Short description|Belgian philosopher (1879–1967)}}
'''Eugène Dupréel''' (February 8, 1879 – February 14, 1967) was a [[Belgians|Belgian]] [[philosopher]]. He had been professor at the [[Université libre de Bruxelles]] from 1907 to 1950, teaching [[logic]], [[metaphysics]], [[Greek philosophy]], [[Ethics|moral philosophy]] and [[sociological theory]]. He developed an ethical theory and a theory of knowledge deeply influenced by [[sociology]], and worked closely with the [[Solvay Institute of Sociology|Institut de Sociologie Solvay]]. Leader of the "École de Bruxelles", he had a major influence on the argumentation theorist [[Chaïm Perelman]] and thus has been instrumental in the renewal of [[rhetoric]].

== Main work ==

(For a complete bibliography, see [https://web.archive.org/web/20120322182340/http://www2.academieroyale.be/academie/documents/DEPREELEugeneARB_198038539.pdf « Notice sur Eugène Dupréel »], 1980, p.&nbsp;71-84.)

* ''Le rapport social : Essai sur l’objet et la méthode de la sociologie'', Paris, Alcan, 1912.
* ''Traité de morale'', 2 vol., Bruxelles, Éditions de la Revue de l’Université, 1932.
* ''Esquisse d’une philosophie des valeurs'', Paris, Alcan, 1939.
* ''Sociologie générale'', Paris, Presses universitaire de France, 1948.
* ''Essais pluralistes'', recueil d’articles, Paris, Presses universitaire de France, 1949.
